name: MU_ParkingPermit_VerifyPayment
description: Serverless API. Confirms a parking-permit payment server-side with Authorize.net before the EIP workflow advances. If transId is provided (e.g. relayed by the iframe communicator), it calls getTransactionDetailsRequest directly. If only registrationId is provided (redirect mode, where the browser never learns the transId), it searches recent unsettled transactions for a matching invoiceNumber. NOTE: search mode only covers unsettled transactions (roughly the last day, before the nightly settlement batch); verify promptly after payment, or pass transId for older transactions. Returns paid=true only for an approved, captured transaction. Never trusts the caller's claim of payment.

parameters.name: authNetLoginId
parameters.label: Authorize.net API Login ID
parameters.description: Authorize.net API Login ID (Account > Security Settings > API Credentials & Keys).

parameters.name: authNetTransactionKey
parameters.label: Authorize.net Transaction Key
parameters.description: Authorize.net Transaction Key. Stored here so it never reaches the browser.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.description: 'sandbox' (apitest.authorize.net) or 'production' (api.authorize.net). Must match the token pipeline.

registrationId.title: Registration ID
registrationId.description: Parking registration id; matched against the Authorize.net invoiceNumber.

transId.title: Transaction ID (optional)
transId.description: Authorize.net transaction id, if known. When omitted, recent unsettled transactions are searched by invoiceNumber.
